coverage: 2000-present: the Governor's executive order archive, with Dalrymple's orders read by date and title from December 2010 and numbered orders from 2017, plus the current-EOs page (dates confirmed per order against news releases); Schafer's and Hoeven's 2000-2010 orders are not on the archive, so Hoeven's March 2004 and March 2009 flood emergencies, June 2005 storm emergency, August 2007 Northwood tornado emergency and January 2010 snow emergency order are added by hand from dated news reports and the Governor's release, and his other orders and undated 2024-2026 orders are still to be backfilled. Orders signed weeks after the storm they declare (2020-41, 2021-14, 2022-09, 2025-06) are compared on the storm's first day, as the Governor's release for each states. Federal declarations since 2000 with no state record yet: DR-1334, DR-1353, DR-1376, DR-1431, DR-1483, EM-3196, DR-1616, DR-1621, DR-1645, DR-1713, DR-1725, DR-1907, EM-3309, DR-1901
